([[Chief executive officer|CEO]] & [[Managing director|MD]])}} | products = {{Bulleted_list|[[Credit card]]s|[[Retail banking|Consumer banking]]|[[Commercial bank|Corporate banking]]|[[Financial services|Finance and Insurance]]|[[Mortgage loan]]s|[[Private banking]]|[[Investment banking]]}} | revenue = {{Increase}} {{INRConvert|1794|c}} (2026)[https://www.dhanbank.com/pdf/financials/Annual_Report_2016-17.pdf "Balance Sheet 31.03.2017"]. dhanbank.com (15 March 2018). | net_income = {{Increase}} {{INRConvert|102.75|c}} (2026) | assets = {{Increase}} {{INRConvert|21237|c}} ( 2026) | equity = | num_employees = 1,856 (March 2026) | ratio = 18.92% | hq_location = [[Thrissur]], [[Kerala]], India | website = {{url|https://dhan.bank.in}} }} '''Dhanlaxmi Bank''' is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in [[Thrissur]], [[Kerala]]. It was incorporated on 14 November 1927 at Thrissur with a capital of {{INR|11000}} and seven employees. It became a [[Scheduled Banks (India)|Scheduled Commercial Bank]] in the year 1977. ==History== The bank changed its name from Dhanalakshmi Bank to Dhanlaxmi Bank on 10 August 2010.{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article-amp/companies/dhanalakshmi-bank-gets-roc-nod-for-name-change-110081400110_1.html|title = Dhanalakshmi Bank gets RoC nod for name change|newspaper = Business Standard India|date = 14 August 2010|agency = Press Trust of India}} In 2020, shareholders voted to remove CEO Sunil Gurbaxani at the bank's [[annual general meeting]], owing to governance issues at the bank.{{cite news |title=After LVB, Dhanlaxmi Bank shareholders oust chief executive Sunil Gurbaxani |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/after-lvb-dhanlaxmi-bank-shareholders-oust-chief-executive-sunil-gurbaxani-120100100016_1.html |access-date=4 July 2023 |work=Business Standard |date=1 October 2020}} In April 2024, the [[Reserve Bank of India]] approved the appointment of Ajith Kumar KK as the managing director and CEO of Dhanlaxmi Bank for three years. Kumar will succeed incumbent CEO & MD J.K. Shivan.{{cite news |title=Dhanlaxmi Bank gets RBI approval for Ajith Kumar KK as MD and CEO|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/dhanalxmi-bank-gets-rbi-approval-for-ajith-kumar-kk-as-md-and-ceo-12672081.html |access-date=19 April 2024 |work=Moneycontrol |date=19 April 2024}} In 2010, shares of Dhanlaxmi Bank reached an all-time high of nearly Rs 200 during strong market momentum in the banking sector. ==Operations== Dhanlaxmi Bank has deployed a Centralised Banking Solution (CBS) on the [[Flexcube]] platform at all its branches for extending anywhere/anytime/anyhow banking to its clientele through multiple delivery channels. The bank has set up a data centre in Bangalore, to keep the networked system operational round the clock. Reserve Bank of India empanelled the Bank as agency Bank for Government agency Business.{{Cite web|url=https://www.rbi.org.in/CommonPerson/English/Scripts/Content.aspx?Id=2139|title=Name of Agency Bank (Reserve Bank of India (List))}} In 2022, Dhanlaxmi Bank introduced Customs duty collection services through digital services and Goods and Services Tax(GST) collection through online and over the counter methods.{{Cite news |date=2022-04-21 |title=Dhanlaxmi Bank signs MoU with CBDT and CBIC for tax collection |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/dhanlaxmi-bank-signs-mou-with-cbdt-and-cbic-for-tax-collection/articleshow/90980395.cms |access-date=2025-09-17 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} ===Partnerships=== The bank is a depository participant of NSDL (National Security Depository Limited) offering Demat services through select branches. It has partnered with AGS Infotech for the installation of ATMs. It offers VISA & Rupay-branded debit cards and VISA-branched credit cards to customers. It is also offering insurance services through Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance and CANARA HSBC OBC LIFE company as their [[Bancassurance]] life insurance channel partner and Bajaj Allianz General Insurance as General Insurance Channel Partner. ===Credit cards=== In March 2010, the bank launched Dhanlaxmi Bank Platinum Credit cards.{{cite news |url=http://www.business-standard.com/india/storypage.php?autono=389390 |title=Dhanlaxmi Bank launches credit cards |work=Business Standard |access-date=2010-03-28}} ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[Reserve Bank of India]] * [[Indian Financial System Code]] * [[Kerala Bank]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * {{official website|https://www.dhan.bank.in/}} {{Thrissur topics}} {{Banking in India}} [[Category:Banks established in 1927]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1927]] [[Category:Banks based in Thrissur]] [[Category:Private sector banks in India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]

Dhanlaxmi Bank is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala.
It was incorporated on 14 November 1927 at Thrissur with a capital of ₹11,000 and seven employees. It became a Scheduled Commercial Bank in the year 1977.
